vsm1.1:25.1: 10. Idāni yaṃ vuttaṃ katividhaṃ cetaṃ sīlanti, tatridaṃ vissajjanaṃ.
vsm1.1:25.2: Sabbameva tāva idaṃ sīlaṃ attano sīlanalakkhaṇena ekavidhaṃ.
vsm1.1:25.14: Vuttampi cetaṃ paṭisambhidāyaṃ ‘‘pañca sīlāni – pariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ, apariyantapārisuddhisīlaṃ,
vsm1.1:26.4: Yaṃ ‘‘idaṃ na kattabba’’nti paṭikkhittassa akaraṇaṃ, taṃ vārittaṃ.
vsm1.1:26.6: Caranti tasmiṃ sīlesu paripūrakāritāya pavattantīti cārittaṃ.
vsm1.1:27.8: Tenāha – ‘‘pubbeva kho panassa kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ ājīvo suparisuddho hotī’’ti (ma. ni. 3.431).
vsm1.1:27.9: Yāni vā sikkhāpadāni khuddānukhuddakānīti vuttāni, idaṃ ābhisamācārikasīlaṃ.
vsm1.1:27.14: Tenevāha – ‘‘so vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā ādibrahmacariyakaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī’’ti (a. ni. 5.21).
vsm1.1:29.1: Catutthaduke nissayoti dve nissayā taṇhānissayo ca diṭṭhinissayo ca.
vsm1.1:29.2: Tattha yaṃ ‘‘imināhaṃ sīlena devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’’ti (dī. ni. 3.320; ma. ni. 1.186; a. ni. 5.206; 7.50) evaṃ bhavasampattiṃ ākaṅkhamānena pavattitaṃ,
vsm1.1:29.6: Yaṃ pana lokuttaraṃ lokiyañca tasseva sambhārabhūtaṃ,
vsm1.1:30.1: Pañcamaduke kālaparicchedaṃ katvā samādinnaṃ sīlaṃ kālapariyantaṃ.
vsm1.1:31.3: Vuttampi cetaṃ paṭisambhidāyaṃ ‘‘katamaṃ taṃ sīlaṃ sapariyantaṃ? Atthi sīlaṃ lābhapariyantaṃ, atthi sīlaṃ yasapariyantaṃ,
vsm1.1:31.4: atthi sīlaṃ ñātipariyantaṃ, atthi sīlaṃ aṅgapariyantaṃ,
vsm1.1:31.6: Katamaṃ taṃ sīlaṃ lābhapariyantaṃ? Idhekacco lābhahetu lābhapaccayā lābhakāraṇā yathāsamādinnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ vītikkamati,
vsm1.1:31.9: Apariyantavissajjanepi vuttaṃ ‘‘katamaṃ taṃ sīlaṃ na lābhapariyantaṃ? Idhekacco lābhahetu lābhapaccayā lābhakāraṇā yathāsamādinnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ vītikkamāya cittampi na uppādeti,
vsm1.1:31.11: idaṃ taṃ sīlaṃ na lābhapariyanta’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.38).
vsm1.1:32.3: Tattha lokiyaṃ bhavavisesāvahaṃ hoti bhavanissaraṇassa ca sambhāro.
vsm1.1:32.4: Yathāha – ‘‘vinayo saṃvaratthāya, saṃvaro avippaṭisāratthāya, avippaṭisāro pāmojjatthāya, pāmojjaṃ pītatthāya,
vsm1.1:32.5: pīti passaddhatthāya, passaddhi sukhatthāya, sukhaṃ samādhatthāya, samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassanatthāya,
vsm1.1:32.6: yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidatthāya, nibbidā virāgatthāya, virāgo vimuttatthāya,
vsm1.1:32.8: etadatthā kathā, etadatthā mantanā, etadatthā upanisā, etadatthaṃ sotāvadhānaṃ, yadidaṃ anupādācittassa vimokkho’’ti (pari. 366).
vsm1.1:32.9: Lokuttaraṃ bhavanissaraṇāvahaṃ hoti paccavekkhaṇañāṇassa ca bhūmīti
vsm1.1:33.1: 12. Tikesu paṭhamattike hīnena chandena cittena vīriyena vīmaṃsāya vā pavattitaṃ hīnaṃ.
vsm1.1:33.7: ‘‘Ahamasmi sīlasampanno, ime panaññe bhikkhū dussīlā pāpadhammā’’ti evaṃ attukkaṃsanaparavambhanādīhi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ vā hīnaṃ.
vsm1.1:34.1: Dutiyattike attano ananurūpaṃ pajahitukāmena attagarunā attanigāravena pavattitaṃ
vsm1.1:34.3: Lokāpavādaṃ pariharitukāmena lokagarunā loke gāravena pavattitaṃ
vsm1.1:35.5: Sekkhāsekkhānaṃ phalasampayuttaṃ paṭippassaddhanti evaṃ parāmaṭṭhādivasena tividhaṃ.
vsm1.1:36.1: Catutthattike yaṃ āpattiṃ anāpajjantena pūritaṃ, āpajjitvā vā puna katapaṭikammaṃ, taṃ visuddhaṃ.
vsm1.1:36.3: Vatthumhi vā āpattiyā vā ajjhācāre vā vematikassa sīlaṃ
vsm1.1:37.1: Pañcamattike catūhi ariyamaggehi tīhi ca sāmaññaphalehi sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ sekkhaṃ.
vsm1.1:38.1: Paṭisambhidāyaṃ pana yasmā loke tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ pakatipi sīlanti vuccati, yaṃ sandhāya
vsm1.1:38.2: ‘‘ayaṃ sukhasīlo, ayaṃ dukkhasīlo, ayaṃ kalahasīlo, ayaṃ maṇḍanasīlo’’ti bhaṇanti,
vsm1.1:38.6: Tattha akusalaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetassa sīlassa lakkhaṇādīsu ekenapi na sametīti idha na upanītaṃ,
vsm1.1:39.2: Yodha sevati dussīle, sīlavante na sevati; Vatthuvītikkame dosaṃ, na passati aviddasu.
vsm1.1:39.3: Micchāsaṅkappabahulo, indriyāni na rakkhati; Evarūpassa ve sīlaṃ, jāyate hānabhāgiyaṃ.
vsm1.1:39.4: Yo panattamano hoti, sīlasampattiyā idha; Kammaṭṭhānānuyogamhi, na uppādeti mānasaṃ.
vsm1.1:39.5: Tuṭṭhassa sīlamattena, aghaṭantassa uttari; Tassa taṃ ṭhitibhāgiyaṃ, sīlaṃ bhavati bhikkhuno.
vsm1.1:39.6: Sampannasīlo ghaṭati, samādhatthāya yo pana; Visesabhāgiyaṃ sīlaṃ, hoti etassa bhikkhuno.
vsm1.1:39.7: Atuṭṭho sīlamattena, nibbidaṃ yonuyuñjati; Hoti nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ, sīlametassa bhikkhunoti.
vsm1.1:40.1: Dutiyacatukke bhikkhū ārabbha paññattasikkhāpadāni, yāni ca nesaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ paññattito rakkhitabbāni,
vsm1.1:40.3: Bhikkhuniyo ārabbha paññattasikkhāpadāni, yāni ca tāsaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paññattito rakkhitabbāni,
vsm1.1:40.6: Upāsakaupāsikānaṃ niccasīlavasena pañcasikkhāpadāni, sati vā ussāhe dasa, uposathaṅgavasena aṭṭhāti idaṃ gahaṭṭhasīlanti
vsm1.1:41.3: ‘‘Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajji kāmaguṇūpasaṃhita’’nti evaṃ vuttaṃ bodhisattamātusīlaṃ dhammatāsīlaṃ.
vsm1.1:41.4: Mahākassapādīnaṃ pana suddhasattānaṃ, bodhisattassa ca tāsu tāsu jātīsu sīlaṃ pubbahetukasīlanti
vsm1.1:42.1: Catutthacatukke yaṃ bhagavatā ‘‘idha bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesū’’ti (vibha. 508; dī. ni. 1.193) vuttaṃ sīlaṃ,
vsm1.1:42.3: Yaṃ pana ‘‘so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī, yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ,
vsm1.1:42.4: tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
vsm1.1:42.5: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā…pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā…pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā…pe…
vsm1.1:42.6: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī…pe… manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.22, 411; dī. ni. 1.213; a. ni. 4.198) vuttaṃ, idaṃ indriyasaṃvarasīlaṃ.
vsm1.1:42.7: Yā pana ājīvahetupaññattānaṃ channaṃ sikkhāpadānaṃ vītikkamassa, ‘‘kuhanā lapanā nemittikatā nippesikatā lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanatā’’ti evamādīnañca pāpadhammānaṃ vasena pavattā micchājīvā virati,
vsm1.1:42.9: ‘‘Paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati, yāvadeva sītassa paṭighātāyā’’ti (ma. ni. 1.23; a. ni. 6.58) ādinā nayena vutto paṭisaṅkhānaparisuddho catupaccayaparibhogo paccayasannissitasīlaṃ nāma.
